objective: Determine whether independent CPU FP32 replay of two frozen H9b crop refiners reduces numerical disagreement with the archived original probability maps and the 58 P71 RLE divergences.
hypothesis: CUDA FP16 and GPU arithmetic may explain some or all P70 uint8 differences; CPU FP32 may change direction or magnitude, without any promise of exact parity.
protocol: Use unchanged h9_infer.py, unchanged checkpoints and 180 immutable crop NPZ packs, --device cpu, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; perform inference for resnet34 then efficientnet_v2_s. Compare uint8 probabilities to frozen references and P70, then run unchanged H9b paste and compare to accepted 58112557 using independent P90 auditor. Report negative results.
gates: SHA256 of checkpoints must equal preregistered hashes
180 crop files, 180 frozen probability entries per refiner
No labels or GT or leaderboard read
No CUDA process created by this study
Output only to NAS HDD; no large SSD writes
Do not overwrite accepted CSV or completed artifacts
decision: No model/threshold tuning and no Kaggle upload. Numerical diagnostic only; publish reproducibility status and remaining blockers.
controls: Compare all 180 observations, and report exact vs divergent per image; no selection by score.
validity: Analysis of unlabelled official competition images and already-approved model outputs only; no test labels or score promotion.
